JBiebs.e: Blend of J(ustin) + Biebs (from Bieber), modelled on other abbreviations such as J-Lo.

d.g: Just be white (used sardonically to reflect the belief that white men are greatly advantaged over other men at attracting women)
d.x: ‘JBW’ or ‘Just Be White’—the idea that being white automatically makes you more attractive, particularly to non- white women
